year-view.description: Twelve mini-months with density dots. Activating a day drills into the month view.

drill.note: The month view below shares the same focused date: drill from the year grid and watch the month follow, then pick a day to finish the drill.

examples.note: Use the toolbar to change years. Density dots summarize each day; activating a day sets the focused date and the log below shows the drill event.

installation.note: Install the package and import the standalone year view component.

locales.note: Months, weekdays, and helper texts follow the selected locale.

props.note: Pass events (the lib expands recurrence without mutating the array), tasks, and resolved holidays. Drill-down emits daySelect and moves focusedDate.

size-density.note: Size drives day numbers while density drives mini-month gaps.

year-view.title: Year View
